profile.name: GRBL数控运动控制设备
profile.description: 基于 GRBL 固件的数控运动控制设备，通过串口接收 G-code 指令来驱动多轴运动。常见于小型 CNC 雕刻机、运动平台或激光加工设备，在实验室中可用于样品定位、自动扫描、轨迹运动和简单加工控制。
profile.description_en: A CNC motion control device running GRBL firmware, receiving G-code commands over a serial connection to drive multi-axis motion. It is commonly used in small CNC engravers, positioning stages, or laser processing systems, and in laboratories for sample positioning, automated scanning, trajectory motion, and simple machining control.

registry.name: Grbl Com Serial
registry.description: Grbl COM Serial是由GRBL (Open Source)生产的实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括中止、停止、启动、复位、运行。支持Signal, Slot, clearCom等操作。
